english.note: Use this for shifting your body or position slightly, often with 一下 in speech.
Use this when something or someone begins to move slightly from being still.

examples.english: Shift your position a little first.
examples.jyutping: nei5 juk1 jat1 haa5 go3 wai2 sin1

examples.english: The cat finally began to stir.
